The Bulldogs, led by 25th-year head coach [[James Jones (basketball, born 1964)|James Jones]], played their home games at [[Payne Whitney Gymnasium|John J. Lee Amphitheater]] in [[New Haven, Connecticut]] as members of the [[Ivy League]]. ==Previous season== The [[2023–24 Yale Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 23–10, 11–3 in Ivy League play to finish in second place.
